name: app-backend
title: App Backend (Transactional + API)
description: Architecture blueprint for building application backends on Fabric: a transactional SQL Database (or Cosmos DB) for OLTP, a GraphQL API and/or User Data Functions to expose it, and optional analytics/Data Agent on top. Best for powering apps, not just dashboards.
best_for: Operational applications needing a read-write transactional store plus API/serverless business logic — with optional analytics layered on.
key_ingestion: Application writes via GraphQL API / User Data Functions (not batch ingestion)

item_set.purpose: GraphQL data API over the database
Environment-specific config for promotion across stages
Optional analytics model over operational data
Optional natural-language Q&A over the app data

decisions.guidance: SQL Database for relational OLTP; add Cosmos DB (mirrored) for NoSQL/high-throughput document workloads.
GraphQL for flexible client-driven queries; User Data Functions for custom REST/business logic; direct TDS for trusted server-side callers.
Variable Library is the Fabric-native, CI/CD-friendly choice for per-stage config.

build_with.deploy_ordering: VariableLibrary + SQLDatabase (Foundation/Environment) deploy before UserDataFunction and GraphQLApi; fabio deploy handles ordering.
outline: Create the SQL Database (requires F4+ capacity); optionally a Cosmos DB.
Add User Data Functions for business logic and/or a GraphQL API for data access.
Add a Variable Library for per-environment config.
Promote across environments with fabio deploy (see workflow cicd-deploy).
Optionally add a semantic model + Data Agent for analytics/Q&A.
